name: Africa's Talking

spans: Please note that if you choose to send an SMS, you will need to acquire a Sender ID before sending a message.
Please attach the certificate of registration for your company.

open_questions: Africa's Talking's sign-up (https://help.africastalking.com/en/articles/1036078-how-do-i-register-an-account) asks for a name, an email, a password and a country, but no page says whether an individual without a registered business can use the account in production. Registering an SMS sender ID asks for company documents in several countries (a certificate of incorporation in Nigeria, a certificate of registration in Rwanda, a letter on company letterhead in Côte d'Ivoire, Zambia and Tanzania); the help center does not say what an individual can do there. africastalking.com/terms could not be read (Cloudflare challenge).

description: Africa's Talking is a pan-African communications platform offering SMS, USSD, voice, WhatsApp and airtime APIs (this registry covers SMS and USSD) across multiple African countries.
example_prompt: Send an SMS notification to a Kenyan phone number using Africa's Talking.
